svg.title: Frank's workbench, supervised by Cupid the Cat
svg.desc: frankischilling: IT at Wentworth, GNU/Linux, systems, emulators, compilers and terminal tools. Cupid the Cat projects: cupid-os, cupid-nes, cupid-n64, cupidwm, cupidfm, cherubsh and cupidfetch. Also on the workbench: Axiom64, holyc-ocaml and the Robotron 64 decompilation. Artwork of a fluffy cream and orange cat with blue eyes behind a terminal. Project links are in the profile README below this image.

g.text: X11 window manager & terminal file manager
MADE BY FRANK. SUPERVISED BY CUPID.
